origins.section: Plain ε-Constraint Can Return a Weakly Efficient Plan
Reward the Floor's Slack With a Weight Too Small to Cost Any of the Objective
Jump Past Floors the Slack Already Covers, and Stop at the First Infeasible One

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-weak: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-weak: 8.3.1: "a weakly efficient plan can be dominated by a plan that ties it on one objective and beats it on the other." Q ties P on NPV and removes more risk.
recorded.prompt:q-reward: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-reward: "Get the scale wrong and the slack term becomes a second objective." With a reward of 1, "the big reward gave up $945k of NPV for $2,333k more risk".
recorded.prompt:q-jump: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-jump: "every floor from v up to v + s returns the same plan"; move the floor up by 1 + ⌊s/step⌋ = 7 steps, so 200 + 7 = 207.

recorded.prompt:q-weak:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-weak:b: 8.3.1: a plan is Pareto-optimal only "when no feasible plan dominates it". Q dominates P, and having the best NPV alone is not enough.
recorded.prompt:q-weak:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-weak:c: Weakly efficient means "no feasible plan is strictly better on both". Q ties P on NPV, so it is not strictly better on both.
recorded.prompt:q-weak:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-weak:d: "Lesson 8.3.1 warned that a plain ε-constraint answer is only guaranteed to be weakly efficient"; 6 of 11 plain answers were dominated.
recorded.prompt:q-reward:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reward:a: Only the tiny reward "only breaks ties". A reward of 1 returned a different plan with $945k less NPV.
recorded.prompt:q-reward:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reward:b: "Because s ≥ 0, the equality risk − s = ε says exactly what the old floor said". The reward-1 run returned a plan.
recorded.prompt:q-reward:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-reward:d: The reward-1 run shows "slack 2,554", well above the floor, not on it.
recorded.prompt:q-jump:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-jump:a: "Those solves are redundant. AUGMECON2 skips them with a bypass"; the jump still found the same 5 plans.
recorded.prompt:q-jump:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-jump:c: Floor 206 is still within v..v+s and returns the same plan. The jump formula 1 + ⌊s/step⌋ gives 207.
recorded.prompt:q-jump:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-jump:d: The jump is "1 + ⌊s / step⌋" steps, not twice the slack. For example, "slack 35 -> jump 36 floors".
